blocks.text: Moira Dela Torre said she and her former husband, Jason Hernandez, have moved forward from their past and are now on civil terms. “Yes, we are civil. And actually, we have been civil. I’m happy that the relationships that I have and that we all have, I’m happy that people have moved forward,” Dela Torre said during the press conference for her upcoming concert, “Where It All Started,” in Quezon City on Thursday, Sept. 17.
